list.text: \f[faceprofIvy]\rAh! You must be the courier Professor Elm sent.
\f[faceprofIvy]\rSo that’s the package… may I?
\PN handed the Mysterious Ball Package to Professor Ivy!
\f[faceprofIvy]\r…Incredible.\nWhatever is inside this Mysterious Ball is not ordinary. I’ll begin observation immediately, but that will take time.
\f[faceprofIvy]\rYou didn’t come all this way just to hand over a box.\nYou’re a Trainer, aren’t you?
\f[faceprofIvy]\rThen hear this clearly: this region is not a vacation spot.
\f[faceprofIvy]\rThe Orange Archipelago has its own League: the Orange League. \nIts trials are nothing like the ones in Kanto.
\f[faceprofIvy]\rStrength alone won’t carry you through here.
\f[faceprofIvy]\rIf you intend to stay and challenge the Orange League, you’ll need a partner native to these islands.
\f[faceprofIvy]\rThese three are species that adapted very well here.\nTake one, raise it, and let your journey begin.

then.text: \f[faceprofIvy]\rYou seem to have no room on your party...\nPlease deposit a Pokemon so you can pick the new one.

list.text: \f[faceprofIvy]\rThese three are species that adapted very well here.\nTake one, raise it, and let your journey begin.
\f[faceprofIvy]\rWhile you train, I’ll study this Mysterious Ball.\nWhen I have answers, I’ll call for you.
\f[faceprofIvy]\rOh! You’re here already?\nThat was fast!
\f[faceprofIvy]\rI was just finishing another round of measurements in the Mysterious Ball\nAnd...\nyeah. It’s still emmiting energy.
\f[faceprofIvy]\rAt first I thought it was just residual energy from my earlier tests.
\f[faceprofIvy]\rBut then I noticed something strange.
\f[faceprofIvy]\rThe energy spikes aren’t increasing.\nThey’re repeating.
\f[faceprofIvy]\rSame intensity.\nSame interval.\nOver and over again.
\f[faceprofIvy]\rIt usually means it’s responding to something external.
\f[faceprofIvy]\r...
\f[faceprofIvy]\rA while back, Professor Birch sent me some of his findings from Hoenn.\nHe was studying an unusual Pokémon energy pattern there.
\f[faceprofIvy]\rWhen I compared his data to this...\nThey matched.
\f[faceprofIvy]\rIf the Mysterious Ball is reacting to the same phenomenon, then Hoenn is where the answers are.
\f[faceprofIvy]\rI want you to take it to Professor Birch.
\f[faceprofIvy]\rI know it sounds like another long trip...
\f[faceprofIvy]\rBut if this mystery’s going anywhere, it’s going there with you.
\f[faceprofIvy]\rTake this too.
\f[faceprofIvy]\rYou can get the cruise on Route 49.
\f[faceprofIvy]\rProf. Birch will be waiting for you there.
